definitionZh: 规则风格的CSS短手属性定义了多列网格,弹性,多列布局中列和行之间所绘制的线条样式,将列和行规则的样式设置为相同值.
sourceDefinition: The rule-style CSS shorthand property defines the line style of the lines drawn between columns and rows in multi-column grid, flex, and multi-col layouts, setting the styles of the column and row rules to the same value.
